graphEnableConfirmBody:
Lounge starts its own codebase-memory-mcp Graph UI process on port {{port}}.
It temporarily writes the shared config.json, then restores the previous values once the UI is up — other codebase-memory sessions are not affected.
How to stop: close the Graph window, or quit Lounge (stops only the process Lounge started).

Continue?
graphMsgForeignUiUser: Port {{port}} is serving another codebase-memory-mcp (for example Antigravity). Lounge will not adopt it. In User mode the port is not changed automatically — pick another port in Settings.
graphMsgPortBusyUser: Port {{port}} is in use by another process. In User mode the port is not changed automatically — change Graph UI Port in Settings or stop that process.
graphMsgBandExhausted: Graph UI port band {{start}}–{{end}} is full. Free a port or choose a fixed port in User mode in Settings.
